main_text.l: CANTICVM BEATÆ MARIÆ virginis, Ex primo cap. Euangelij secundum Lucam.

l.i: O[?]UM lata sancti Maria Spiritus Virtute vidu se grauidam, Alitis Et dicta sacri vera, Summum Virgo Deum paritura, dixit
Te cuncta coelo quiregis Arbiter Mens nostra festis tollere laudibus Nunc gestit, & Patrem supremum Magnifico celebrare versu.
O, quanta surgunt pectore gaudia! O, quàm suaui spiritus impetu Miratur exultans salutis Æthereæ Dominum datorem.
Nunc me sereno respiciens Deus Vultu decoris auget honoribus Suamque non vult sorte posthac Sub tenui latitare seruam.
Hinc me beatam post venientibus Gens cuncta sæclis lætior asseret, Quum mira cernet quæ stupendus Rex Superûm mihi fecit author:
Qui cuncta nutu terrifico potest: Iustisque terras imperiis tenet Sacrata qui solus peremni[?]

page.notes: The first word is set with a large woodcut initial that looks like an O; the letter under it is not clear, so the reading "O[?]UM" is doubtful. The printed "VVM" is read as UM under the u/v rule. "vidu" in line 2 of the first stanza is doubtful and may be "vidi". "peremni" at the end is printed as it appears on the scan and may be a printing error for "perennis"; the word is cut at the bottom of the scan, so the ending is uncertain. The stanzas are grouped by the line spacing and indentation on the scan. The running head is not visible; faint show-through from the other side of the leaf is not transcribed.
